syncs.finished_at: when it ended; null while it runs
syncs.error: what stopped a failed run, as the importer reported it

bots.description: what the bot is for, in a sentence, written when it registers
bots.last_seen_at: the last time the bot did anything here
bots.disabled_at: set when the owner switches the bot off; it keeps what it owns

email_threads.subject: the subject of the thread's first email, without Re: and Fwd:
email_threads.last_email_at: when the newest email of the thread was sent
email_threads.emails_count: how many emails of the thread are stored

emails.subject: the Subject header, decoded
emails.from_name: the sender's display name, as written in From
emails.received_at: when the owner's mailbox received it
emails.body_text: the plain-text body; derived from the HTML when the email has no text part
emails.snippet: the first words of the body, for lists
emails.read: 1 when it is marked read in the mailbox
emails.flagged: 1 when it is flagged or starred
emails.draft: 1 for a draft not yet sent
emails.size: the raw email's size, in bytes

email_recipients.name: the display name written beside it

mailboxes.name: the folder or label name as the provider shows it

documents.title: from front matter, the first heading, or the file name, in that order
documents.content_hash: hash of the file's bytes; an unchanged file is not read again
documents.extraction_error: why the text could not be extracted
documents.language: detected language of the body, as an ISO 639-1 code

document_revisions.body: the body as it was before that revision

note_revisions.body: the body as it was before that revision

event_series.title: what the repeating event is called, e.g. the weekly sync

events.title: the owner's title; filled from the first meeting or calendar entry linked
events.location: where it happens: an address, a room, or online
events.timezone: IANA zone the event is held in, e.g. Europe/Madrid

meeting_series.title: the meeting's topic at the provider
meeting_series.description: the agenda, as the provider stores it
meeting_series.join_url: the link to join; also what later matches a calendar entry

meetings.title: this occurrence's topic
meetings.location: a physical room, when the provider says
meetings.join_url: the link to join this occurrence
meetings.duration_ms: how long it lasted, in milliseconds
meetings.timezone: IANA zone the provider gives for the meeting
meetings.participants_count: how many took part, as the provider reports it

meeting_participants.display_name: the name shown in this meeting; a later rename does not change it
meeting_participants.email: the address the provider gives, when it gives one
meeting_participants.duration_ms: time in the meeting, summed over all joins

meeting_transcripts.language: the transcript's language, as an ISO 639-1 code
meeting_transcripts.superseded_at: set when a newer transcript of the same meeting replaces this one; this one is kept

meeting_transcript_rows.start_ms: when the row starts, in milliseconds from the start of the recording
meeting_transcript_rows.text: what was said, without the speaker prefix

meeting_chat_messages.sender_name: the sender's name as the chat shows it

meeting_summaries.title: the summary's own title
meeting_summaries.doc_url: a link to the summary at the provider, when it has one

tasks.title: one line saying what is to be done
tasks.closed_at: when it became done or dismissed
tasks.close_reason: why it was closed, in a few words, e.g. no-reply-needed

task_events.kind: what happened: created, status, assigned, unassigned, due, priority, moved

tags.name: the tag, as the owner writes it; unique

embeddings.content_hash: Hex SHA-256 of the chunk text the embedding model was given; the text itself is never stored.
embeddings.dims: Number of dimensions in the vector (its float32 length).
